keyFindings.description: Security[transport]: an admitted request holds its admission units while its body is read (keyed spool, decodeJSON before requireActor in patchIssue) and a pinned read holds its request-pool connection while its response is written, with no read or write timeout on the server: 12 slow bodies stop every write on a pod, 28 slow readers every read.

settleRoom's new 60 s deadline covers the statements after applySuppressed wrote the stamp or repairs into the room (BroadcastUpdate, AppendUpdateTx, version writes), so a deadline there runs abandon -> failRoom, evicting the room and closing every editor's socket; before, a timer settlement had no deadline.

awaitRoomRecovery refuses inside a transaction but not on a pinned context: a pinned read (artifact text) waits on a failed room's eviction holding its request-pool connection, and the eviction's withRoomLock acquires from the request pool.

The related-item check takes two request connections and decisionBlockChecks runs up to five at once (ten connections), on routes of weight 1 (issue create, ask create, document edits): spec acceptance line 3 says one request cannot take many connections at once.

The writer gate is held across post-commit work: createAskFor defers release past the related check (up to 5 s), createCommentFor past the mention deliveries, so every other writer of the document waits behind them; editArtifact releases before its checks.

store.Overloaded counts any deadline but the request's as DATABASE_BUSY and WriteUnserved logs it at DEBUG: a commit cut off at CommitContext's 10 s bound (unknown outcome) answers 'no connection free' and reaches no ERROR line.
The settlement warm-up drops Settlements()'s error and warms through the request pool, the pool the comment above says it must not use; settlePass then opens Settlements() again and fails on it.
settlePass is one 588-line function with four commit endings, state threaded through pointer-to-pointer and closure parameters, and the room-dead check repeated seven times.

routeServings is a second table keyed by 'METHOD pattern' strings beside the route table; BodyLimit is read only through a string lookup (routeBodyLimit); AGENTS.md names a Stream field apiRoute does not have.
OpenRegistry repeats open step by step and the nested-acquire refusal is written three times (guard, target, handOver); the file grows to 1,010 lines.
A second injectable clock (RetryClock) beside writeRetry's now/pause, its sleep a copy of pauseFor, and writeAnswer keeping its own JSON parse beside answerPayload.
A request whose client went away is answered nothing and the access log records it as status 200, where it was a 500.
target() refuses a nested acquire only for a held connection: a pinned read is handed Background, Live or Settlements connections, which AGENTS.md and dispatch-store.md say it is refused.
The WriteUnserved-then-log-then-500 branch is written five times; one helper.
A hand-built copy of gatedWrite's gate, re-read and documents-moved check, without its redo.

Prose tied to the findings above, for the implementer's push: the weight lists omit the related routes; dispatch-api.md's file count (100) and 'every read pinned'; dispatch-store.md's 'every acquire on every pool bounded' (outbox, registry, health are not); AGENTS.md:2843's withholdAnswers.
